input: 今天我头疼，我该吃什么药。
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Disease) WHERE d.name IN ['头疼', '头痛'] MATCH (f:Formula)-[:TREATS_DISEASE]->(d) RETURN DISTINCT f.name AS formula_name, f.indication AS indication, f.ingredients AS ingredients, f.usage AS usage, f.taboo AS taboo

MATCH (d:Disease) WHERE d.name IN ['头疼', '头痛'] MATCH (h:Herb)-[:TREATS_DISEASE]->(d) RETURN DISTINCT h.name AS herb_name, h.indication AS indication, h.effect AS effect, h.usage AS usage, h.taboo AS taboo
